propositions.name: aether_is_stagnant
propositions.quote: The aether is stagnant on this theory, while the molecules constituting the Earth and all other material bodies flit through it without producing any finite flow in it
propositions.statement: The aether is stagnant and material bodies pass through it without producing any finite flow in it.

propositions.name: axes_at_rest_in_aether
propositions.quote: changing from axes ( x, y, z ) at rest in the aether to axes (x', y', z') moving with translatory velocity v parallel to the axis of x
propositions.statement: There exist axes at rest in the aether relative to which translatory velocity through the aether is defined.

propositions.name: definite_translatory_velocity_through_aether
propositions.quote: we shall attempt to compare the relative motions of these electrons when they form, or belong to, a material system devoid of translatory motion through the aether, with what it would be when a translatory velocity is superposed
propositions.statement: A material system has a definite translatory velocity through the aether that can be superposed on its rest state.

propositions.name: time_measured_in_ordinary_manner
propositions.quote: expressed as functions of x', y', z' and t', the latter being the time measured in the ordinary manner
propositions.statement: The time-variable t' referred to axes moving through the aether is the time measured in the ordinary manner.

propositions.name: observer_apparatus_uniformly_moving
propositions.quote: so as thereby to be in a position to examine how phenomena are altered when the observer and his apparatus are in uniform motion through the stationary aether
propositions.statement: An observer and his apparatus can be in uniform motion through the stationary aether while phenomena are examined.

propositions.name: auxiliary_time_variable_device
propositions.quote: the scheme of equations reverts to the same type as when it was referred to axes at rest, except as regards the factors ε on the left-hand sides
propositions.statement: A change of the time-variable makes the equations revert to the same type as those referred to axes at rest, apart from the factor ε.

propositions.name: c_is_single_aether_constant
propositions.quote: and in which c is the single physical constant of the aether, being the velocity of propagation of elastic disturbances through it
propositions.statement: The velocity c of propagation of elastic disturbances is the single physical constant of the aether.

propositions.name: aether_dynamical_equations_definite
propositions.quote: The medium in which the activity occurs is for our present purpose the free aether itself, whose dynamical equations have been definitely ascertained in quite independent ways
propositions.statement: The dynamical equations of the free aether have been definitely ascertained in independent ways from optics and electrodynamics.

propositions.name: aether_elements_sensibly_at_rest
propositions.quote: the various parts of the aether are supposed to be sensibly at rest, so that for example the time-rate of change of the strain of any element of the aether is represented by differentiation with respect to the time
propositions.statement: The various parts of the aether are sensibly at rest so that the time-rate of change of strain needs no additional convective terms.

propositions.name: astronomical_aberration_rigorously_maintained
propositions.quote: hence the law of the astronomical aberration of light is rigorously maintained, and the Doppler change of wave-length of radiation from a moving source holds good
propositions.statement: The law of the astronomical aberration of light is rigorously maintained on this theory and the Doppler change of wave-length of radiation from a moving source holds good.

propositions.name: terrestrial_optical_phenomena_unaffected
propositions.quote: but it will appear that all purely terrestrial optical phenomena are unaffected by the Earth's motion
propositions.statement: All purely terrestrial optical phenomena are unaffected by the Earth's motion through the aether.

propositions.name: electron_singular_point_in_aether
propositions.quote: An electron e will occur in this analysis as a singular point in the aether, on approaching which the elastic strain constituting the aethereal displacement ( f, g, h ) increases indefinitely
propositions.statement: An electron is a singular point in the aether at which the elastic strain of the aethereal displacement increases indefinitely.

propositions.name: electron_transferable_independently_of_aether
propositions.quote: this singularity represents a definite structure, forming a nucleus of strain in the aether, which is capable of transference across that medium independently of motion of the aether itself
propositions.statement: The electron nucleus of strain is capable of transference across the aether independently of motion of the aether itself.

propositions.name: electron_nucleus_labile_no_inertia
propositions.quote: This however presupposes that the nucleus of the electron is quite labile as regards displacement through the aether, in other words that its movement is not influenced by any inertia or forces except such as are the expression of its relation to the aether
propositions.statement: The electron nucleus is labile with respect to displacement through the aether and is not influenced by any inertia or forces other than its relation to the aether.

propositions.name: structure_of_matter_unaltered_first_order
propositions.quote: the structure of the matter being assumed unaltered to the first order by motion through the aether, so too must be all electric distributions
propositions.statement: The structure of matter is unaltered to the first order by motion through the aether, and so too are all electric distributions.

propositions.name: only_electric_forces_between_atoms
propositions.quote: in which atoms of matter are constituted of aggregations of electrons, the only actions between atoms are what may be described as electric forces
propositions.statement: Atoms of matter are aggregations of electrons and the only actions between atoms are what may be described as electric forces.

propositions.name: deterministic_evolution_from_initial_state
propositions.quote: from a knowledge of the state of the system at any time t the state at the time t + δt can be immediately expressed, and so by successive steps
propositions.statement: From a knowledge of the state of the system at any time t the state at the time t plus δt can be immediately expressed by successive steps.

propositions.name: electrons_occupy_corresponding_positions
propositions.quote: Thus the electrons in the two systems here compared, being situated at the singular points at which the concentration of the electric displacement ceases to vanish, occupy corresponding positions
propositions.statement: The electrons in the two systems compared, being at the singular points of concentration of the electric displacement, occupy corresponding positions.

propositions.name: electron_strengths_equal_across_systems
propositions.quote: as the amount of electricity inside any boundary is equal to the integral of the normal component of the aethereal displacement taken over the boundary, it follows by taking a very contracted boundary that the strengths of the corresponding electrons in the two systems are the same
propositions.statement: The strengths of the corresponding electrons in the two systems compared are the same, to first order.

propositions.name: first_order_null_effect_on_distributions
propositions.quote: uniform translatory motion through the aether does not produce any alteration in electric distributions as far as the first order of the ratio of the velocity of the system to the velocity of radiation is concerned
propositions.statement: Uniform translatory motion through the aether does not produce any alteration in electric distributions as far as the first order of the ratio of the velocity of the system to the velocity of radiation is concerned.

propositions.name: displacements_differ_by_first_order
propositions.quote: though the fixed and the moving system of electrons of this correlation are at corresponding instants identical, yet the electric and magnetic displacements belonging to them differ by terms of the first order
propositions.statement: Though the fixed and moving system of electrons are at corresponding instants identical, the electric and magnetic displacements belonging to them differ by terms of the first order.

propositions.name: epsilon_second_order_negligible
propositions.quote: which is of the second order of small quantities; hence we have the following correspondence when that order is neglected
propositions.statement: The factor ε differs from unity by the second order of small quantities and can be neglected in the first-order correspondence.

propositions.name: free_mobility_of_electron
propositions.quote: including therein the permanence and characteristic properties of an electron and its free mobility through the aether
propositions.statement: An electron has permanence and characteristic properties together with free mobility through the aether.

propositions.name: maxwell_equations_experimentally_verified
propositions.quote: the theoretical investigations of Maxwell, in combination with the experimental verifications of Hertz and his successors in that field, have imparted to this analytical formulation of the dynamical relations of free aether an exactness and precision
propositions.statement: Experimental verifications of Hertz and his successors have imparted to the analytical formulation of the dynamical relations of free aether an exactness and precision unsurpassed in any other department of physics.
